head: c0c31459

findings.summary: Smoke child's stderr is captured but never surfaced in the receipt; non-launch failures collapse to a bare id.
findings.failure_scenario: Xvfb present but cannot start; the receipt shows only smokeExitCode 1.

findings.summary: chromium.launch error text discarded before exit(LAUNCH_FAILED).
findings.failure_scenario: Missing shared library after an image update is undiagnosable.

findings.quote: for (const context of opened.reverse()) await context.close();
findings.summary: finally without try: a close error replaces the original failure.
findings.failure_scenario: Readback mismatch masked by a context.close() throw.

findings.summary: Bare catch around executablePath() downgrades an unexpected throw to 'no managed payload'.
findings.failure_scenario: A Playwright upgrade break masked as benign absence.

findings.summary: Only SIGTERM is exercised end-to-end; SIGINT (Ctrl-C) handler registration is never proven.
findings.failure_scenario: A SIGINT-branch regression leaves Xvfb/Chrome running.

findings.summary: processTable() reads /proc with no platform guard; on a host without /proc (macOS with a stale DISPLAY) the smoke crashes outside try/finally instead of returning the designed UNAVAILABLE code, and the browser it launched has no verified cleanup.
findings.failure_scenario: macOS + leftover XQuartz DISPLAY + Playwright Chromium present → uncaught ENOENT in the smoke.

findings.summary: child.pid recorded before the async spawn 'error' event; an undefined pid reaches process.kill(-undefined) in the interrupt handler and throws inside it.
findings.failure_scenario: SIGINT in the spawn-error window dies via uncaught exception instead of the structured receipt and exit 130.

findings.quote: the session already owns, and retries the next candidate — the `xvfb-run`
findings.summary: Doc says switch display then browser; the planner tries both browsers on the current display before switching displays (the test encodes display-outer/browser-inner).
findings.failure_scenario: An operator concludes xvfb-run was tried when it never was.

test_command: Cloud image only: env -u DISPLAY npm run diagnose:headed-browser; env -u DISPLAY npm run test:headed-browser (reads /proc). Any host: node --check local/headed-browser-*.mjs; bash -n scripts/conductor-cloud-setup.sh. Never run the full conductor-cloud-setup.sh as verification (it resets a DB). Residual: zombie rows in scanProcessGroups on a non-reaping PID 1.
